mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_change_bundles (user_id, conversation_id, source_message_id, status, revision, range_start, range_end, basis_fingerprint) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{sourceMessageId}, 'PROPOSED', 1, #{rangeStart}, #{rangeEnd}, #{basisFingerprint})

INSERT INTO ai_change_bundle_items (bundle_id, user_id, seq, op_type, target_key, op_json, summary, depends_on, origin, selected, status, check_code, check_message) VALUES (#{bundleId}, #{userId}, #{seq}, #{opType}, #{targetKey}, #{opJson}, #{summary}, #{dependsOn}, #{origin}, #{selected}, 'PROPOSED', #{checkCode}, #{checkMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_change_bundles WHERE bundle_id = #{bundleId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM ai_change_bundles WHERE bundle_id = #{bundleId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ai_change_bundles WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND apply_idempotency_key = #{key}
SELECT * FROM ai_change_bundle_items WHERE bundle_id = #{bundleId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY seq
SELECT * FROM ai_change_bundle_items WHERE bundle_id = #{bundleId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY seq FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ai_change_bundles WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bundle_id
SELECT * FROM ai_change_bundles WHERE source_message_id = #{sourceMessageId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bundle_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_change_bundle_items SET selected = #{selected} WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND bundle_id = #{bundleId} AND status = 'PROPOSED'
UPDATE ai_change_bundle_items SET op_json = #{opJson}, check_code = #{checkCode}, check_message = #{checkMessage} WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND bundle_id = #{bundleId} AND status = 'PROPOSED'

UPDATE ai_change_bundles SET revision = revision + 1, basis_fingerprint = COALESCE(#{basisFingerprint}, basis_fingerprint), range_start = COALESCE(#{rangeStart}, range_start), range_end = COALESCE(#{rangeEnd}, range_end) WHERE bundle_id = #{bundleId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND status = 'PROPOSED'
UPDATE ai_change_bundle_items SET status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson} WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND bundle_id = #{bundleId} AND status = 'PROPOSED'

UPDATE ai_change_bundles SET status = #{status}, apply_idempotency_key = #{key}, apply_request_hash = #{requestHash}, apply_result_json = #{resultJson}, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE bundle_id = #{bundleId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PROPOSED'
